svg.title: Relay Fleet Telemetry
svg.desc: Relay Fleet Telemetry (SpaceXAI, internal): read-only telemetry for datacenter protective relays and breaker trip units with drift detection and human-gated writes.
svg.text: Read-only telemetry for datacenter protective relays and
breaker trip units, with drift detection against design.
Python · FastAPI · MySQL · Modbus · Docker · Ansible
